verification_instructions: From repo root, all must pass with zero errors, in this order: 1) npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), 2) npm run lint (eslint), 3) npm run test (vitest run), 4) npm run build (next build). Baseline today is green: 9 test files / 40 tests pass. Keep that green and add new tests.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell: use ';' to chain, never '&&'. Work on the main checkout at d:\devs\El-Kema-platform — no worktree/branch. Do NOT use Figma asset URLs at runtime (they expire); draw the progress ring with SVG. Do NOT change tokens (globals.css), fonts, or atom styling. Do NOT add dependencies.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: this Next.js has breaking changes vs training data — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs when touching framework APIs. Server Components are the default; add 'use client' only for state/handlers/browser APIs (per docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md). Navbar is a Server Component (async, getTranslations); keep it so.
key_patterns: Atoms live in src/components/ui and follow: `cn` from @/lib/utils/cn, `cva` for variants (export xxxVariants + component), data-slot attributes, forwardRef where a DOM ref is idiomatic (input.tsx, radio-group.tsx), focus-visible ring token `focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px]`, logical properties only (ps/pe/ms/me/start/end, rounded-s/e — never left/right), semantic token utilities (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-primary-light, bg-primary-light-strong, text-primary-foreground). Selected/pressed state reflected via `data-state` + aria (see tags.tsx: aria-pressed/data-state). i18n: client components use useTranslations, server components use getTranslations; add keys to BOTH messages/ar.json and messages/en.json in sync. Icon module @/components/icons re-exports lucide under semantic names (SearchIcon, DownArrowIcon, LeftArrowIcon=ChevronLeft, RightArrowIcon=ChevronRight) but does NOT export Eye/EyeOff — import those from 'lucide-react' directly. Tests: Vitest + Testing Library, query by role/name, assert aria-*/data-state, userEvent for interaction (see button.test.tsx, tags.test.tsx).
